sentences.text: It is my aunt's old house.
My old home is not like this house.
That is a picture on the wall.
It is a picture of my aunt.
Her eyes are dark and sad.
It is not a good picture.
The shadow is on the wall.
The shadow is in my room.
The shadow is on the wall near my bed.
I am in the dark room.
I am not alone in the dark house.

questions.text: Is the house big or small?
